assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated sprite for a cozy virtual dog shelter web UI. Match the inspected food-enrichment.png reference style: crisp chunky pixel-art clusters, stepped pixel silhouettes, dark chocolate-brown outlines, warm cream and honey/light brown palette, muted blue and leafy green accents, gently shaded retro game sprite, front three-quarter view. True transparent PNG background with alpha, including transparent empty space inside and around the object group. No painted background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow, no words, logos or watermark. No dogs or people. Keep the complete object silhouette within the canvas with comfortable clear margins. Do not create a sheet or multiple alternatives. Produce exactly one final image.
Primary request: one giant communal dog kennel, a wide low welcoming timber doghouse as the central shelter home. A large open front reveals cozy cream bedding and muted blue folded blankets inside. Warm honey-brown wood walls, broad pitched brown roof, cream roof trim. Broad horizontal shape, substantially wider than tall, landscape composition within the canvas, attractive and clearly readable at about 500 pixels wide. Roof and open front are the dominant clear forms. No exterior props or scenery.

visualValidation.visualInspection: Inspected generated PNG through view_image. Wide timber communal doghouse, open cozy bedding interior, brown pitched roof and cream trim, no dogs or people. Decorative generic bone and paw motifs added by generation. Brown diffuse halo remains around exterior silhouette.
visualValidation.status: partial: real alpha exists, but exterior brown halo fails the clean isolated background requirement
visualValidation.alphaStatus: Real alpha and fully transparent corners verified; maximum alpha 254 and no fully opaque pixels. No alpha modification performed.
